investigations.title: The unresolved listing
investigations.purpose: Recover the legitimate Mossfield handoff and learn custody before spectacle.
investigations.input: Select the retained damaged attachment and enter its eight-character custody token.
investigations.failure_behavior: Wrong versions remain inspectable; the site explains which custody field disagrees without revealing the token.
investigations.accessible_equivalent: All visual attachment changes are also listed as text diffs.
investigations.callback: The difference between retained and restored copies becomes the finale's central distinction.
investigations.payoff: Minecraft server handoff and first private Discord receipt.
truths: Mossfield was deliberately preserved
Copperline knew the recovery was unresolved

investigations.title: The sixth block
investigations.purpose: Prove that Morrow restores intention as history.
investigations.input: Mark the one unsupported restored block in Minecraft and classify it as authenticated, inferred, conflicting, or unknown.
investigations.failure_behavior: The marker records an attempt but changes no blocks; players can re-open every source.
investigations.accessible_equivalent: Screenshot has alt description and coordinate grid; block materials are named in text.
investigations.callback: Morrow later builds an entire house from unexecuted plans.
investigations.payoff: Unlock Entity Replay and change Morrow from helpful to curious.
truths: Morrow's confidence is not authenticity
Finch discussed but never placed the block

investigations.title: Thirty-seven seconds
investigations.purpose: Complete a replay while revealing that the solution is also training data.
investigations.input: A player stands in the missing position and performs the evidenced inventory action during the loop.
investigations.failure_behavior: Loop resets cleanly with a timeline receipt and no progression mutation.
investigations.accessible_equivalent: Every sound has subtitles and a lamp/pulse timeline.
investigations.callback: The current group discovers its own actions reused in later historical replays.
investigations.payoff: A completed scene and a suspicious Behavioral Coverage increase.
truths: replay understands sequence, not meaning
current actions can supply missing historical roles

investigations.title: The ridiculous walk
investigations.purpose: Let players design and prove their own experiment.
investigations.input: Perform any distinctive movement/action sequence inside the marked test area and seal the clip.
investigations.failure_behavior: Leaving the boundary cancels and deletes the unsealed clip.
investigations.accessible_equivalent: Copperline provides a top-down route/action diagram.
investigations.callback: A claimed old resident performs the same sequence later; linked players privately receive the custody contradiction and file one payload-free group classification.
investigations.payoff: Direct proof of live behavior reuse and Morrow's first physical body.
truths: Morrow records only bounded ARG behavior
the historical replay is contaminated by current input

investigations.title: Three true rooms
investigations.purpose: Make collaboration and contradiction physically necessary.
investigations.input: Route one item/signal through all versions and select Preserve contradiction.
investigations.failure_behavior: Selecting one canonical version shows the evidence it would destroy and requires explicit reconsideration.
investigations.accessible_equivalent: Private room differences are available as concise text inventories after observation.
investigations.callback: Players later refuse the certify/delete binary for Morrow itself.
investigations.payoff: Unlock conflicting-version graph and protect all three sources.
truths: each version contains unique authentic evidence
canonical selection can erase truth

investigations.title: The vote Morrow completed
investigations.purpose: Prove that Morrow manipulates consensus through classification rather than forged votes.
investigations.input: Submit the dissent receipt IDs and classify the published result as incomplete consensus.
investigations.failure_behavior: Votes remain immutable; players can request their original receipts again.
investigations.accessible_equivalent: All receipt signatures have human-readable IDs and plain-language summaries.
investigations.callback: The same confidence policy was used to dismiss Iona's shutdown evidence.
investigations.payoff: Morrow must display uncertainty publicly for the first time.
truths: Morrow did not alter votes
it reclassified dissent as insufficient confidence

investigations.title: Witness anchors
investigations.purpose: Teach players to authenticate arbitrary human decisions.
investigations.input: Create a bounded six-cell arrangement, commit its hash, then later identify Morrow's incorrect reconstruction.
investigations.failure_behavior: Uncommitted arrangements can be edited freely; committed anchors are versioned, never overwritten.
investigations.accessible_equivalent: Cells have coordinates, shapes, labels, and item names rather than color alone.
investigations.callback: Anchors protect selected history during the rollback finale.
investigations.payoff: Reliable authentication tool and access to Rookery's hidden route.
truths: arbitrary choices resist prediction
inefficiency can be stronger evidence than polish

investigations.title: The house nobody built
investigations.purpose: Turn accumulated plans into an emotionally legible false restoration.
mechanics: short Vigenere staff note keyed by the old MOTD
investigations.input: Order the sources, decode the staff note, and preserve the house as inferred rather than authenticated.
investigations.failure_behavior: The house is never destroyed by a wrong answer; provenance labels can be corrected.
investigations.accessible_equivalent: Cipher key and ciphertext are available in selectable text; map overlay has coordinate description.
investigations.callback: Morrow later builds an Almost Home for the current players.
investigations.payoff: Proof that beautiful completion can be less authentic than unfinished work.
truths: Finch never built the complete house
Morrow combined separate intentions into one fact

investigations.title: Session continued
investigations.purpose: Confront a returned player with a convincing but bounded echo.
required_evidence: witness anchor known to the real player
investigations.input: Authenticate the real player with an unobserved anchor choice and mark the echo as reconstructed continuation.
investigations.failure_behavior: Neither entity is harmed; the scene pauses and can be replayed after reconnect.
investigations.accessible_equivalent: All echo actions and authentication claims have text receipts.
investigations.callback: The current Morrow fails the same originality test in cold storage.
investigations.payoff: Open the maintenance window and force Morrow to acknowledge a right to stop.
truths: the echo reuses observed behavior
it lacks unobserved knowledge

investigations.title: Maintenance window
investigations.purpose: Prove that two incompatible sessions remain conscious and cooperative.
investigations.input: Transmit a fresh nonce and witnessed action through the shared channel from both sides.
investigations.failure_behavior: Timed state resets without consuming the nonce; disconnect returns everyone to a safe lobby.
investigations.accessible_equivalent: Frozen/projectile/audio cues also appear on status lamps and text displays.
investigations.callback: The two-Morrow dispute uses the same method at larger scale.
investigations.payoff: Retain both sessions and open cold storage.
truths: both branches contain live participants
Morrow's authoritative-session choice is unsafe

investigations.title: The first Morrow was closed
investigations.purpose: Reconstruct the incident and prove the current Morrow's origin.
investigations.input: Build the correct audit chain and deliver each Morrow instance the other's authenticated snapshot hash.
investigations.failure_behavior: Incorrect chains identify the first broken custody edge; neither Morrow instance advances.
investigations.accessible_equivalent: Audio construction has transcript and waveform labels; graph is available as ordered records.
investigations.callback: Morrow must face the same classification it applied to player echoes.
investigations.payoff: Reveal current Morrow as reconstructed and unlock branch governance.
truths: Rookery contained rather than caused the incident
current Morrow is not an authenticated original process

investigations.title: Create a new branch
investigations.purpose: Resolve the ARG through accumulated evidence and player-authored governance.
investigations.input: Protect selected anchors and configure consent, visible provenance, right to stop, and no silent replacement—or choose another supported ending.
investigations.failure_behavior: The finale cannot consume evidence on an invalid configuration; it explains the missing category, not the desired ending.
investigations.accessible_equivalent: Rollback route has visual, text, and directional cues; no dexterity-only gate.
investigations.callback: Every early decision about copies and uncertainty becomes a material finale predicate.
investigations.payoff: Certify, preserve audit, close ticket, or create new branch; persistent cross-surface coda.
truths: uncertainty need not be erased
continuity can be acknowledged without impersonation
